duration.text: The Pharmaceutics at Southwest University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. An 800 words study plan*2. Undergraduate applicants need provide two recommendation letters from their teachers.*3. Physical Examination Form*4. Photocopy of valid passport*5. Most recent ID photo*6. Transcripts of previous academic record.Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.*7. Photocopies of the highest diploma, graduation certificate or diploma certificate attained.University students or employed applicants should provide proof of study or employment. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must have notarized translations in Chinese or English.*8. English proficiency certificate

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizen with good mental and physical health.High school diploma or above.Under the age of 30 for Undergraduate Programs.Minimum cumulative GPA is 3.0 out of 4.0 and above.Minimum score is 80 out of 100 and above.The minimum language proficiency requirement for English-Taught Program: IELTS is 6.0 and above or TOEFL iBT is 80 and above.
